tools.name: extract_sds
tools.description: Extract one Safety Data Sheet PDF into a normalized 16-section record (product identification, hazards, composition, first aid, transport, regulatory, and more) plus a confidence_score and warnings. Provide the PDF as file_url (a public https URL) or file_base64. Billed per document from prepaid cre

tools.name: submit_bulk_extraction
tools.description: Submit up to 10 SDS PDFs (public https URLs) as one asynchronous job. Returns a job_id; poll get_bulk_job until status is completed or failed. Reuse the same idempotency_key when retrying so no duplicate job is created. Billed per document from prepaid credit, reserved up front and released for any

tools.name: get_bulk_job
tools.description: Get the status and per-file results of a bulk extraction job created by submit_bulk_extraction. Read-only and safe to repeat. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the prepaid credit balance, price per document, and the last 30 days of usage for the account that owns the API key. Read-only. Requires a per-customer API key.
